client.title: tg.py
client.description: Path to tg.py; empty: client_path from the project's .telegent.json

config.title: Config
config.description: Path to the telegent config; empty: the project's .telegent.json

triage.title: Secretary
triage.description: Sort new messages with a small model, retell requests, draft status replies

classifyPerHour.title: Secretary calls per hour
classifyPerHour.description: Model calls the secretary may make in an hour; past it, messages follow the plain rule

secretaryModel.title: Secretary model
secretaryModel.description: Alias or id of the model for sorting and retelling

autoReplyStatus.title: Auto-reply status questions
autoReplyStatus.description: Send the secretary's draft answer to status questions without a press; requests, alerts and decisions always wait for one

fileGuard.title: File guard
fileGuard.description: When a file is held by someone else's file:<path> claim: off, ask (a dialog in modes that ask) or deny (stops the edit in every mode)

boardAuto.title: Board updates
boardAuto.description: After a turn, at most every 10 minutes, set the board's 'now' line from the answer

wakeIdle.title: Wake when idle
wakeIdle.description: Start a turn when mail for the agent arrives while the session is idle

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval, s
pollSeconds.description: How often the desk checks the server
